reviews.comment: this course is the lab is heavy and you will be doing alot of reports, they are not graded too harshly. Homework every other week also not graded heavy, 2 exams worth 25% each, these exams are HARD and the conceptual questions are niche. Shor really cares about his students and is a very good prof, however his exams like I said are very hard.

Clear grading system, respectful and caring, wants you to succeed! Best way to prepare for exams is to understand what's going on during the lab, UNDERSTAND THE HW, and pay attention in class. Dr. Shor does his best to make sure you understand the material, and he's very accessible outside of class. I would 100% take him again.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Graded by few things
